primary_scheme: Sample all 32 projects with replacement, 32 draws, retain all rows and use identical source weights for both methods and references
secondary_scheme: Retain one copy of the focal project, resample 31 other projects with replacement; conditional background-composition analysis
point_predictions_and_labels: Preserved fixed ML probabilities/threshold and original project-level rule counts; no training or reference relabeling beyond the already observed focal complement
comparisons: Paired ML minus rule, both references, and difference of contrasts across references
reporting: Point estimates, percentile 2.5/50/97.5 resampling ranges, valid-draw counts, order reversal fractions, focal-omission effects; fractions are not p-values or posterior probabilities
degeneracy: Undefined denominators yield NaN and are excluded per metric with counts reported; AP requires R>0; AUROC/BA require R>0,S>0; MCC requires nonzero denominator
limitations: Projects are selected and may share institutions or isolates; resampling ranges are descriptive source-composition sensitivity, not population confidence guarantees
One known source event cannot establish replicated clinical validity
The second scheme conditions on retaining the known event and is not an independent validation
Aggregate rule margins suffice for whole-project resampling; per-isolate paired rule predictions are not reconstructed
Continuous ML score vs binary 0/1 rule score is preserved
independent_clinical_track: Attempt public primary MIC+genome records, verify assay/standard/identity and training overlap before claiming new model validation
